state:
**Side goal `test-scratch-and-hover`, stage 2 done as far as it can go without a call from the user; stage 3 (hover) is next.** `nvs_repo::scratch(name) -> Scratch` (`crates/nvs-repo/src/lib.rs`) is a fresh directory `target/test-scratch/<name>-<pid>-<n>`, deleted when the guard drops. `nvs_repo::scratch_private(name)` is `case/` inside one such directory locked to this account, for a test that runs the ownership check.

The guard `no_test_code_writes_into_the_system_temp_dir` is in `crates/nvs-repo/tests/scratch.rs`, with `SUBJECT` (empty) and the `NOT_YET_MOVED` ratchet. Moving a site means lowering or deleting its row in the same commit.

**All of `nvs-cli` and `nvs-lsp` are moved, and so is `nvs-config/tests/trust.rs`** (on `scratch_private`). 42 calls are left, in `nvs-db`, `nvs-footprint`, `nvs-hir`, `nvs-host`, `nvs-runtime`, `nvs-server`, `nvs-stdlib`, `nvs-test`, `nvs-types` and `nvs-config/tests/control.rs`. A test `TempDir` struct now holds `path: nvs_repo::Scratch` and has no `Drop` of its own. A URI-only site makes a `Scratch` in the helper and names `case.nvs` inside it.

**`crates/nvs-config/tests/control.rs:49` is not moved, on purpose.** It is a Unix socket path, and a socket path has a limit of about 104 bytes on macOS. A path under `target/test-scratch/` in a deep checkout can pass it. Moving it, or listing it in `SUBJECT` with that reason, is the user's call: the standing decision says no test writes into the temp directory.

`crates/nvs-lsp/src/suite.rs:339` (`Materialised::write`, the `lsp-test` runner) writes each case into the system temp directory. It is not test code, so the guard does not see it.
